svg.title: Seats after the election
svg.desc: Parliament with 200 seats and 6 parties: Left alliance 38 (19.0%), Greens 24 (12.0%), Social democrats 41 (20.5%), Liberals 18 (9.0%), Conservatives 52 (26.0%), Populists 27 (13.5%). A majority takes 101 seats. Coalition Greens + Social democrats + Liberals + Left alliance: 121 seats, a majority.
